uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2872-5921-5970-8201.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Clever Conjurer.
Activate one of the Clever Conjurer tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Clever Conjurer token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

539-1491-6218-6627.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

339-677-1322-4247.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2438-6772.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Syr Vondam and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1170-3375-3698-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3375-3698-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to The Immortal Sun.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell. When the artifact enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact.
Repeat.

2653-2893-4826-7886.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Beorn's Hospitality trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Beorn's Hospitality trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4762-7821-7822.description:
Activate Thranduil using Greenhilt Trainee's ability by tapping it, giving Thranduil +4/+4 until end of turn.
Activate Thranduil using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
4762-7821-7822.notes: Once Thranduil has infinite toughness, you can use Devoted Druid's first ability instead in step 1, or target other creatures using Greenhilt Trainee's ability.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1987-4668-6991.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
1987-4668-6991.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
1987-4668-6991.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Donnie & April.
When Donnie & April enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-4668-6991.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

2301-2946-3967-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2301-2946-3967-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3944-5220-6900-7452.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2741-4186-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2741-4186-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury

2726-6747-7043.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
2726-6747-7043.description:
Cast Aang by paying {W}{U}
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying Aang.
Resolve the copy of the Aang spell. When it enters, it triggers, airbending the Aang spell still on the stack.
Cast the Aang spell from exile by paying {0}.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying Aang.
Resolve the copy of the Aang spell. Put either Aang token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Aang token from step 5 enters, it triggers, airbending the Aang spell still on the stack.
Repeat from step 4.

5075-5231-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
5075-5231-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Ogre Slumlord and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

132-5200-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures that share a creature type.
132-5200-7013.description:
Activate Myr Welder using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {U}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.
132-5200-7013.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

178-3259-6968.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
178-3259-6968.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Adeline as attackers.
Adeline triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2438-2478-2866-4986.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1170-2478-4211-6862.easyPrerequisites: One of the artifacts must be in your hand, while the other is either in your graveyard or in your library.
1170-2478-4211-6862.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Delivery Moogle.
When Delivery Moogle enters, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for the other artifact and putting it into your hand.
Activate the artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2534-3817-6542-6797.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Coercive Recruiter, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coercive Recruiter from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

560-2558-5226-5727.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, The Prydwen triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Prydwen trigger, creating a 2/2 Human Knight and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

1580-2060-2921-6701.description:
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
1580-2060-2921-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature except Terra

1753-6575-6685.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Mesmerizing Dose.
When the Mesmerizing Dose token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Repeat from step 2 two additional times, from Esper Terra's second and third chapter abilities triggering.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3698-5362-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
You have enough mana to cast Quantum Misalignment
3698-5362-5365.description:
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Lonis that isn't legendary.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
When the Clue enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
When the Clue enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat from step 2.
3698-5362-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

2558-3698-5687-5692.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Weapons Trainer, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

2092-2208-4499.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
2092-2208-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Charming Scoundrel.
When Charming Scoundrel enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2104-3982-5003.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Living Lore.
Living Lore does not have summoning sickness.
2104-3982-5003.description:
Deal combat damage to a player or permanent using Living Lore.
Living Lore triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Living Lore dies, its reflexive ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Living Lore trigger, causing you to cast Temporal Manipulation from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Living Lore from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
As Living Lore enters the battlefield, choose to exile Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

121-832-1371-3765.description:
Cast Thoughtseize by paying {B}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Thoughtseize.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Worldfire.
Resolve each Worldfire on the stack, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Resolve the first opponent's copy of Thoughtseize, causing them to lose 2 life.
The opponent loses the game due to having less than zero life.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining opponent.

617-2068-2173.notablePrerequisites:
Each opponent's life total is no greater than 40.
You control at least 18 other nonland permanents.
617-2068-2173.description:
Activate Bolas's Citadel by tapping it and sacrificing ten other nonland permanents you control.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Bolas's Citadel's ability.
Resolve both Bolas's Citadel abilities, causing each opponent to lose 20 life.
Each opponent that had 20 or less life loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Bolas's Citadel.
Activate Bolas's Citadel by tapping it and sacrificing itself, Voltaic Key, and eight other nonland permanents you control.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Bolas's Citadel's ability.
Resolve both Bolas's Citadel abilities, causing each opponent to lose 20 life.
Each remaining opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

3621-5003-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it and Nim Deathmantle triggers.
Resolve the Su-Chi Cave Guard trigger, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Su-Chi Cave Guard's power.
Repeat.

1558-2558-4139.description:
Activate Thopter Foundry by paying {1} and sacrificing Sword of the Meek, creating a 1/1 Thopter creature token and gaining 1 life.
The Thopter token enters the battlefield, triggering Sword of the Meek, returning it to the battlefield and attaching it to the Thopter token.
Repeat until you have 5 Thopters tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing 5 Thopter tokens, taking an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
